# Exterro

> Exterro is an AI-powered data risk management platform unifying eDiscovery, digital forensics, privacy compliance, and information governance for legal, IT, security, and forensic investigation teams.

Exterro serves Fortune 100 companies, law enforcement agencies, government organizations, and legal teams worldwide with integrated solutions for litigation support, digital investigations, regulatory compliance, and data lifecycle management. The platform combines advanced AI capabilities with industry-leading forensic tools like FTK (Forensic Toolkit) to address complex data challenges across multiple business functions.

## Key Topics

- eDiscovery
- Digital Forensics
- FTK Forensic Toolkit
- Data Risk Management
- Legal Hold
- Privacy Compliance
- Information Governance
- Document Review
- FOIA & Public Records
- Compliance Automation
- Remote Mobile Discovery
- FedRAMP
- Law Enforcement
- Cost Savings
- Unified Platform

## eDiscovery Solutions

- [eDiscovery | Legal](https://www.exterro.com/why-exterro/legal): Exterro eDiscovery and forensics solutions for legal teams and litigation workflows
- [eDiscovery | Legal Hold](https://www.exterro.com/e-discovery-software/legal-hold): Automated legal hold management and in-place preservation technology
- [eDiscovery | Data Management](https://www.exterro.com/e-discovery-software/data-management): AI-powered collection, processing, review in unified eDiscovery platform
- [eDiscovery | Review](https://www.exterro.com/e-discovery-software/review): Exterro Review: AI-powered document review reducing volume by 68%
- [eDiscovery | Request Management](https://www.exterro.com/e-discovery-software/request-management): AI-powered workflow automation for legal project and case management
- [eDiscovery | FOIA & Public Records Response](https://www.exterro.com/e-discovery-software/foia-public-records-response): Automated FOIA and public records request management and deadline tracking

## Digital Forensics & Investigations

- [Digital Forensics | FTK Forensic Toolkit](https://www.exterro.com/digital-forensics-software/ftk-forensic-toolkit): Exterro FTK: industry-leading digital forensics toolkit for evidence analysis
- [Digital Forensics | FTK Central](https://www.exterro.com/digital-forensics-software/ftk-central): FTK Central: collaborative forensic review and real-time evidence sharing
- [Digital Forensics | FTK Imager](https://www.exterro.com/digital-forensics-software/ftk-imager): FTK Imager: free forensic imaging and evidence acquisition tool
- [Digital Forensics | Forensic Investigators](https://www.exterro.com/why-exterro/forensic-investigators): Exterro FTK Central for enterprise digital forensics and corporate investigations
- [Digital Forensics | Remote Mobile Discovery](https://www.exterro.com/data-risk-management-platform/remote-mobile-discovery): Wireless mobile data collection for eDiscovery and forensic investigations

## Governance & Compliance Solutions

- [Information Governance](https://www.exterro.com/why-exterro/information-governance): Information governance platform for IT teams: data retention, classification, deletion
- [Privacy Compliance](https://www.exterro.com/why-exterro/privacy): Privacy compliance automation: DSARs, RoPAs, DPIAs, consent management
